geometry_basis: Cylindrical outer envelopes at the published nominal size, not an OEM surface model. Dimensions include the foot without its release liner.
budget_basis: Published dimensional tolerance plus separate design budgets for loaded compression and local floor deflection. The two load budgets are not measured properties.
fit_note: Four perimeter feet plus one beside the intake. Apply to clean, flat, fully finished bonding areas. Verify adhesion on the actual case material and measure the loaded intake gap after warming the assembly.
